mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full-stack Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET backend development and Angular frontend technologies.
The ideal candidate should have solid experience building scalable enterprise applications, APIs, and modern web platforms, while also being familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and modern software development practices to improve productivity and innovation.
This role requires strong technical ownership, system-thinking capabilities, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams in an Agile software development environment.
Full-stack Software Development:
Design, develop, maintain, and optimize full-stack web applications using .NET technologies and the Angular framework.
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications and APIs.
Develop RESTful APIs, backend services, and frontend user interfaces.
Ensure application performance, scalability, responsiveness, and security.
Optimize database performance, application workflows, and system reliability.
Backend Development (.NET):
Develop backend systems using .NET Core/ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework, and RESTful APIs.
Integrate applications with cloud platforms, mobile applications, and third-party services.
Support microservices architecture and backend integrations when required.
Frontend Development (Angular):
Develop and maintain frontend applications using Angular.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to create responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
Ensure frontend performance optimization and cross-browser compatibility.
Integrate the frontend application with the backend APIs and Services.
AI-Assisted and DevOps
Utilize AI-assisted coding tools to improve software development productivity and code quality.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical and production issues.
Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and DevOps processes.
